name: SmokeCompositeB
title: Smoke composite component B
description: PAT-259 component B: adults in the denominator, >= 50 excluded, >= 30 in the numerator → 2 / 3 = 66.667 %.
cqlContent:
library SmokeCompositeB version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<DateTime>

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 18

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"

define "Denominator Exclusions":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 50

define "Numerator":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 30
